knownSimplifications: The 'Category Comparision' sheet in the Sienna workbook was not extracted: it is a redundant/derivative view of the 'Category wise' sheet (same categories x channels x months, re-sliced by year) and its column blocks are inconsistently populated in the source file (e.g. some 'HP <year>' blocks are duplicated with different year ranges, one block only reaches 2023 while an adjacent one reaches 2026). Extracting it as-is risked introducing duplicate or contradictory SalesRecord rows against 'Category wise'.
Section header rows with no numeric values (e.g. 'Operating Costs') in the CEPL/Cafe P&L sheets were not stored as LineItems -- they're layout dividers, not data.

Amount vs percentage LineItems are distinguished by a magnitude heuristic (values with |v| <= 1.5 are treated as a percentage/ratio), not by parsing the row label text, since a few percentage rows in the source sheets have blank or malformed labels.
LineItem.category (revenue / cogs / hr_cost / operating_cost / subtotal / other) is assigned by keyword matching on the row label and should be spot-checked, not treated as authoritative.

CEPL Overview sheet: only FY2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23 and 2021-22 rows were imported from this sheet (as lower-granularity 'Sales (Overview)/Expense (Overview)/Profit & Loss (Overview)' LineItems) for F&B and Store. FY2025-26 was skipped here because it's already captured at full line-item granularity from the individual department sheets. Trading Items/Pottery/Batik/Stitching don't appear in Overview at all in the source file.

Cafe weekly sheets (Sept 2025 onward) break down by outlet/section (Bosar Ghor, Dinning Room, Rannaghor) rather than by week-of-month like the April-August sheets do; both are preserved as-is via BusinessUnit rather than forced into one consistent shape, since that's how the source data is actually organized.

5 raw Excel date-serial numbers in 'Category wise' header cells (e.g. 44672.0) that openpyxl did not auto-convert to dates were manually decoded from the Excel epoch; flagged in the recovered period's label for traceability.

Sienna channel names were normalized to 5 canonical values (e.g. 'HP' and 'HP Store' both map to 'HP Store') since the 'Overall sales' and 'Category wise' sheets use different naming for the same channels.
